description: Defines the AppDao interface for database operations related to applications, including insertions, updates, queries, and deletions. Implements complex data retrieval and diffing logic for app metadata, localized files, and app list items within an Android app using Room persistence library.

classes.description: Interface defining database operations for app data management.
